title: WP900 G8 v2 trace completeness does not authenticate re-entry event origin
target: F2-WP-900 generation 8 condition-blind trace-complete reentry observation

finding.trace_improvement: G8 v2 correctly strengthens negative absence: no-reentry is admitted only when the declared trace window is finalized, covers the source sequence without gaps/drops/overflow, and binds filter/clock identities. Incomplete traces become UNKNOWN.
finding.remaining_positive_origin_gap: ReentryObservationWindowRecorder.observe_reentry still accepts caller-supplied reentry_ref and reentry_sha256 and appends a REENTRY event directly. It does not consume a factory-origin runtime event or prove membership in the bound trace source.
finding.remaining_trace_origin_gap: close_with_trace accepts source/captured sequence bounds, gap/drop/overflow counters, raw_trace_sha256, filter identity, clock identity and finalized as caller arguments, then factory-seals those values locally. The current binder does not receive the canonical raw trace bytes, recompute raw_trace_sha256 from those bytes, derive the counters from the trace, or derive REENTRY membership from that same trace.
finding.causal_consequence: A condition-aware caller can still manufacture a self-consistent repository candidate by invoking observe_reentry only for the intervention arm and supplying syntactically valid zero-loss trace metadata for both arms. Trace completeness hardens absence accounting but does not by itself make positive event origin independent of the orchestrator.

counterexample.setup: Use two otherwise matched identities and observation windows. Supply equal valid-looking trace-source/filter/clock identities and zero gap/drop/overflow counts. Without an independently observed downstream re-entry event, call observe_reentry with an arbitrary valid-looking ref/digest only in the intervention arm, then finalize both traces with self-consistent caller-supplied sequence metadata.
counterexample.current_false_green_shape: The intervention receipt can become REENTRY_OBSERVED, the control receipt NO_REENTRY_OBSERVED_IN_COMPLETE_TRACE, and bind_matched_reentry_mechanism can produce MECHANISM_REENTRY_DIFFERENCE_CANDIDATE even though the distinguishing event was injected by the condition-aware caller.

required_closure.architecture_rule: Do not add a second truth/event authority. Reuse an existing typed/runtime event source or a single canonical raw trace as the observation authority.
minimum_requirements: The re-entry observation must consume a source-authenticated event object or canonical raw trace entry; a public caller-supplied ref/digest pair alone must be insufficient.
raw_trace_sha256 must be recomputed from the exact persisted trace bytes used for classification, not accepted as an unattached digest assertion.

sequence bounds, gap/drop/overflow status and REENTRY membership should be derived or verified from that same bound trace/source receipt rather than independently supplied as mutually trusting fields.
event/source identity must bind exact source, boot, execution context, task, runtime/process, opportunity/window and clock/filter identities.
A re-entry from another task/runtime/window/source must fail closed even if its digest is syntactically valid.
A condition-aware direct call without authenticated source membership must fail closed or remain UNKNOWN.
An unexpected genuine control-side re-entry from the authenticated source must remain REENTRY_OBSERVED and prevent false absence.
Persist the full canonical fresh trace/event payloads plus hashes on the eventual owner-VPS run; do not repeat the historical G4 digest-only availability defect.

scope_fence: This packet does not invalidate accepted G4/G7 bounded runtime evidence and does not reject G8 v2 as a useful repository recorder. It blocks calling the current v2 result independent/non-circular mechanism evidence for promotion until event-source/raw-trace origin is authenticated. Repository CI may prove implementation behavior only; target runtime, GWT, semantic GWT/J-Space, physical GRID10, effects, training, completion and whole-system credits remain zero.
anti_duplication: REVIEW_ONLY/CANDIDATE_FALSIFIER. No WP900 owned source, tests, workflow, active pointer, receipt, reconciliation or generation is mutated by this packet.
next_exact_action: Active WP900 G8 owner should either bind v2 to an existing source-authenticated event/trace path and add the caller-injection/raw-trace hard negatives, or keep G8 explicitly below independent re-entry evidence. Do not dispatch a promotion-bearing G8 VPS subject while event origin remains caller-asserted.
